title: Aye musafir
body:
Aye musafir
<<MINI>>
Alwida, alwida, alwida..(4)
Aye musafir, be kafan tu, khaak par wa hasrata
Mai musafir shaam ki hu, dushmano mein berida
Alwida, alwida, alwida..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ae musafir..
1. Boli zainab, ae mere maa jaye ye kya haal hai
kaise pehchanu tera laasha bohot pamaal hai
aah re anta akhi kya, hai tu hi bhaiyya mera
<<MINI>>
mai musafir shaam ki hu,.....
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kya tumhi ho ibne zehra, kya tumhi ibne ali
kya tumhi bhai hasan ke, aur jaane zainabi
ae gule baagh e mohammad, haal ye kya hogaya
<<MINI>>
mai musafir shaam ki hu,.....
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Na rahi nalayn, na malboos, na dastaaar hai
ae ghareeb e fatima, tu khuld ka sardaar hai
ae tane uryaa'n tera to, aaj sab kuch lut gaya
<<MINI>>
mai musafir shaam ki hu,.....
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Mai rasan basta chali, waada nibhane ke liye
ghar me qatil ke teri, masnad bichane ke liye
kal yahi masnad banadungi, teri farshe azaa
<<MINI>>
mai musafir shaam ki hu,.....
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Bhai, amma, aur nana ka, padar ka waasta
baat kar mujh se baradar, kholde aankhein zara
dekh to chehra behan ka, kis qadar murjha gaya
<<MINI>>
mai musafir shaam ki hu,.....
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Laasha e besar tadapkar ye sada dene laga
ae behan waada nibhake, mai to maqtal se chala
thi sadaa rehan o sarwar, haaye khwahar alwida
<<MINI>>
Mai musafir shaam ki hu, dushmano mein berida
Aye musafir, be kafan tu, khaak par wa hasrata
Mai musafir shaam ki hu, dushmano mein berida
Alwida, alwida, alwida..(4)
